contract: Xbox virtual-memory allocation/protection/query provenance backed by GuestHeap

primary_references.name: Microsoft Learn: NtQueryVirtualMemory
primary_references.used_for: page-rounded query address, MemoryBasicInformation class, matching-attribute subregions

primary_references.name: Microsoft Learn: NtAllocateVirtualMemory
primary_references.used_for: reserve/commit/free states, input/output rounding semantics, PAGE_* allocation protection and NOCACHE/WRITECOMBINE modifiers

primary_references.name: Microsoft Learn: NtFreeVirtualMemory
primary_references.used_for: release changes a region to free and makes it available for later allocation

primary_references.name: Microsoft Learn: MEMORY_BASIC_INFORMATION
primary_references.used_for: BaseAddress/AllocationBase/RegionSize fields; MEM_COMMIT/MEM_RESERVE/MEM_FREE; undefined fields for MEM_FREE; MEM_PRIVATE/MEM_IMAGE

primary_references.name: Microsoft Learn: VirtualQuery
primary_references.used_for: coalescing only consecutive pages with common state/protection/allocation attributes

xbox_abi_cross_check.scope: Xbox 7xBE32 (28-byte) query layout plus NtAllocate/NtFree/NtProtect/MmQuery/MmSet argument and PAGE_* flag shape cross-checks only; implementation not copied

services_summary.facts: region_type=0; dynamic r3; output stack+96; reads +0/+12/+16; state comparisons include MEM_COMMIT/MEM_RESERVE

generated_callsite.facts: NtQuery call sites 0x829A6130 and 0x829A6188; r30=0x10000 MEM_FREE in the surrounding scan; MmQueryAddressProtect consumers mask return with 0x600 (NOCACHE|WRITECOMBINE)

implemented_runtime_provenance.GuestHeap: live containing-allocation and allocator-region lookup; initial AllocationProtect; current PAGE_* protection spans; metadata removed on free
implemented_runtime_provenance.Runtime: existing virtual_allocations/physical_allocations sets remain allocation-family ownership authority
implemented_runtime_provenance.GuestMemory: unchanged; authoritative only for host page commit/base access, never for Xbox cache/write-combine modifiers or host-reservation-as-guest-state
